Record what computed a derived product

Source: R/provenance.R
hydrosense_provenance.Rd

LMF and msPAF are derived products: they depend on this package's code as much as on the data. hydrosense_provenance() returns a small named list identifying the code and the time of a computation, for the caller to store beside the derived values (hydroSense itself writes nothing anywhere).

Usage

hydrosense_provenance()

Value

A named list:

package_version

character(1), the installed hydroSense version.

git_sha

character(1) commit SHA, or NA_character_.

r_version

character(1), the R version.

computed_at

POSIXct(1) in UTC, the time of the call.

Details

git_sha comes from the RemoteSha field recorded when the package was installed from GitHub. When the package is loaded from a source checkout (for example with devtools::load_all()) it is the checkout's HEAD, read with git rev-parse. Otherwise (a CRAN or local-tarball install, or no usable git) it is NA.

Examples

hydrosense_provenance()
#> $package_version
#> [1] "0.2.0"
#> 
#> $git_sha
#> [1] NA
#> 
#> $r_version
#> [1] "4.6.1"
#> 
#> $computed_at
#> [1] "2026-10-28 03:47:03 UTC"
#>
